title: SecOps-NG Vulnerability Response Band
description: Shared four-band vocabulary for the response branch a vulnerability-intake case is routed onto after triage. Promoted out of the F-WF-01 vulnerability-triage CACAO playbook (which declared the four bands in prose only on its switch-condition step) so that the vulns evidence-stream schema, the F-WF-01 severity primitive's downstream consumers, and any future effectiveness-loop stream import the same enum without re-declaring it. Bands are mutually exclusive: a triaged case is routed onto exactly one band per execution.

x_band_definitions.critical: Severity policy resolved to Critical; the response chain emits an emergency patch / advisory + regulator-notification clock checks per CRA Article 14.
x_band_definitions.high: Severity policy resolved to High; the response chain emits a prioritised patch / advisory inside the operator's documented High dissemination SLA.
x_band_definitions.scheduled: Severity policy resolved to Medium or Low; the response chain schedules remediation against the next routine release cadence.
x_band_definitions.accept: Operator has accepted residual exposure for this case (compensating controls in place, asset out of support, or risk explicitly accepted by the owning role). The acceptance rationale is captured in `response.accept_rationale` on the evidence record.
